newsitem.title: CHINA: China CNTIC sees profit at 140 mln yuan in 2000.
newsitem.headline: China CNTIC sees profit at 140 mln yuan in 2000.

text.p: China's Technical Import & Export Corporation (CNTIC) said on Tuesday it forecast total turnover at 5.0 billion yuan ($602 million) a year in 2000 and pre-tax profit at 140 million yuan,.

Its annual import and export business was expected to increase at an annual average of more than 15 percent up to 2000 with the total reaching $5.0 billion a year by the end of the century, a company official said.
CNTIC issued 27 million domestic currency A shares on the Shanghai stock exchange on Monday.
